mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing prochlorperazine levels, while both agents have antiplatelet properties that may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine side effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms) and bleeding signs; consider alternative antiemetic if high-dose turmeric supplementation is used.
